MI_senate.label: 2024 president on the 2026 court ordered lines
MI_senate.source: 2024 presidential margin by 2026 Michigan Senate district, Wikipedia 2026 Michigan Senate election; lines from the Crane A1 remedial map approved July 26, 2024 in Agee v. Benson
MI_senate.note: Michigan's Senate map was redrawn by court order in Agee v. Benson, approved July 26, 2024, for the 2026 elections. Each district's lean is the 2024 presidential vote on the new lines, and the 16 metro Detroit districts that were redrawn carry no weight from their 2022 results. The map's shapes for the redrawn districts still follow the older lines.

WI_senate.label: 2024 president
WI_senate.source: Odd numbered districts are up in 2026 on the 2024 legislative maps; their 2022 results were on the old lines, so the 2024 president vote is summed from the three Assembly districts in each
WI_senate.note: Wisconsin's legislative maps were redrawn in 2024. Each Senate district's 2024 presidential vote is summed from its three Assembly districts on the new lines, and the 2022 results, which were on the old lines, carry no weight.
